sentences.text: Horseshoe Falls , also known as Canadian Falls , is one of three waterfalls which collectively form Niagara Falls on the Niagara River along the Canada-US Border .	Niagara River	Niagara River	Niagara Falls	Niagara Falls	Canada-US Border	Canada-US Border	US	United States	Canadian	Canada
Approximately 90 % of the Niagara River , after diversions for hydropower generation , flows over Horseshoe Falls .	Niagara River	Niagara River	hydropower generation	Hydroelectricity
The remaining 10 % flows over American Falls and Bridal Veil falls .	American Falls	American Falls	Bridal Veil falls	Bridal Veil Falls (Niagara Falls)

It is located between Terrapin Point on Goat Island in the US state of New York , and Table Rock in the Canadian province of Ontario .
